mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, principal_type, principal_id, workspace_id, mode FROM coding_workspace_access WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND principal_type = #{principalType} AND principal_id = #{principalId} ORDER BY workspace_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO coding_workspace_access(tenant_id, principal_type, principal_id, workspace_id, mode) VALUES (#{row.tenantId}, #{row.principalType}, #{row.principalId}, #{row.workspaceId}, #{row.mode}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id, principal_type, principal_id, workspace_id) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO coding_workspace_access(tenant_id, principal_type, principal_id, workspace_id, mode) VALUES (#{row.tenantId}, #{row.principalType}, #{row.principalId}, #{row.workspaceId}, #{row.mode}) ON CONFLICT(tenant_id, principal_type, principal_id, workspace_id) DO UPDATE SET mode = excluded.mode
